name: Spectacles of Spell Reading
body:
Price 2,500 gp; Aura faint divination; CL 3; Weight 1 lb.

DESCRIPTION

These multi-lensed spectacles grant the user a +5 competence bonus on Spellcraft and Use Magic Device checks relating to scrolls.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 1,250 gp; Feats Craft Wondrous Item, read magic
